notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Mam row; The earlier run's notes say the 1450 growth of Later Mayan City-States takes in Zaculeu's country, so that shape and this one may overlap.
THIN. Everything before 1525 is bridge. The Zaculeu page has the K'iche' conquest 'traditionally ... in the 15th century' but 'may have taken place as early as the 12th century' on a revised dating, so the vassal pair could start earlier. The page says 'Mam kingdoms' (plural) in one sentence. The K'iche' dossier records the Mam lands as a gain at 1435 with counterpart 'Mam, Rabinal and Sacapulas lords'.
GAZETTEER. 'Zaculeu' is not in it; Huehuetenango is.
